column1:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to
Mullaittivu via Hambantota, Batticaloa and Trincomalee. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few
places in the other sea areas around the island in the evening or night.

Winds will be North-westerly to northerly in the sea areas from Mullaittivu to Colombo via
Kankasanthurai and Puttalam. Winds will be variable in the other sea areas around the island. Wind speed
will be (20-30) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (40-45) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast
extending from Matara to Mullaittivu via Hambantota, Batticaloa and Trincomalee.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Matara to Mullaittivu via Hambantota, Batticaloa and
Trincomalee will be fairly rough at times. Other sea areas around the island will be moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
